notes: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes_blind_original: The report rates the paper 'partially computationally reproducible': scripts ran unchanged (only an empty .here marker was added), and the primary bet-amount results reproduce. Issues not in the claim list: Wald χ² drift in the cash-out mixed models (e.g. 26.54 vs 27.99), which the authors' response attributes to lme4/car versions; the Exp 2 Spearman df (85 vs 78); N = 180 vs 178 records; and several analyses without code (figures, bootstrap CIs, permutation tests; some since added per the authors' response). The authors' response (OSF file 6a8e3414...) does not address the C1/C2 β/SE copy error. C1/C2 are reporting errors rather than code errors, but the printed number itself is wrong and unchanged code yields a different value, so they are labelled discrepant. The published version could not be accessed (Sage returned 403); printed values were checked against the OSF preprint.pdf in the package, which may be the accepted manuscript.
